title: platform_setting
description: Role grants, feature flags and kill switches -- plus, since 1.2.f (F12/F23), the per-region economy settings table. `proposedBy` is only present on a `region_setting.*` key: it is what lets `approve_setting`'s separation-of-duties rule (the approver differs from the proposer) be expressed in CEL, the same shape `ledger_adjustment.yaml`'s `R.attr.createdBy == P.id` uses.
